definitions.explanation: A relatively small number or group compared to the whole.
A number less than one expressed with a decimal point.

examples.japanese: {少数|しょうすう}{派|は}の{意見|いけん}も{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: The opinions of the minority are also important.

examples.japanese: {少数|しょうすう}の{人|ひと}だけが{知|し}っている。
{少数|しょうすう}{点|てん}の{計算|けいさん}をする。

notes:
{少数|しょうすう} has two main meanings: a small number/minority and decimals in mathematics.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {少数|しょうすう}{派|は}: minority group
- {少数|しょうすuu}{民族|みんぞく}: ethnic minority
- {少数|しょうすう}{精鋭|せいえい}: select few
